name: hyperflow
description: Markdown-only Direct, Focused, and Deep workflows for safe planning, implementation, review, and Git handoff in Codex (preview).

interface.longDescription: Hyperflow routes work through Direct, Focused, or Deep lanes and exposes seven lazy-loaded surfaces: hyperflow, plan, dispatch, trace, audit, deploy, and handoff. It keeps project memory and plans in Markdown, uses child agents only for independent work or independent judgment, preserves security and Git gates, and performs no automatic startup work. Codex CLI, app-server, and desktop App compatibility are verified separately; this manifest does not claim certification for one surface from another.
